svg.aria-label: Complete wiring diagram: a 4S LiFePO4 pack feeds a fused plus 12 volt rail; the rail supplies an MH-MINI-360 buck converter that makes 5 volts for an ESP32-C3-Zero, and an INA219 high-side shunt that feeds the DRV8871 H-bridge driving the linear actuator. The ESP32 talks I2C to the INA219 on GPIO8 and GPIO9 and drives the bridge inputs from GPIO6 and GPIO7.
